item.title: Video REC v2.14.0
item.description: Photo source: Interactive Powers Video REC v2.14.0 We are pleased to announce that our new Video REC v2.14.0 has been released for suitable production services. This new version adds Single Sign-On (SSO) via SAML, including full login, callback, and per-user auth provider configuration. All users with previous maintained versions can upgrade today. Please contact our support! ## [2.14.0] - 2025-05-23 ### Added - SSO integration via SAML, including login flow, callback handling, and user-level auth provider config ### Changed - Renamed `processingTimeout` server config variable to camelCase for consistency ### Fixed - Increased timeout on server and webapp for service deletion plus suppressed S3 CLI output to prevent buffer errors during bucket cleanup Interactive Powers - Streamline your business communications

item.title: Video REC v2.13.0
item.description: Photo source: Interactive Powers Video REC v2.13.0 We are pleased to announce that our new Video REC v2.13.0 has been released for suitable production services. Please contact our support! ## [2.13.0] - 2025-01-21 ### Changed - Updated Slack notification method to use Web API instead of Incoming Webhook - Improved styles for child rows ### Fixed - Fixed sidebar toggle icon when resizing screen Interactive Powers - Streamline your business communications

item.title: Video REC v2.11.0
item.description: Photo source: Interactive Powers Video REC v2.11.0 We are pleased to announce that our new Video REC v2.11.0 has been released for suitable production services. This new version adds an IP allow-list for login and password-reset actions, plus full activity logging for blocked attempts. All users with previous maintained versions can upgrade today. Please contact our support! ## [2.11.0] - 2024-12-03 ### Added - Added IP Allowed feature for some pre login actions: login, login-otp and reset-password - All user actions are now logged in the User Activity Logger when actions are blocked Interactive Powers - Streamline your business communications

item.title: Video REC: Latest Updates
item.description: Photo source: Interactive Powers - Freepik Enhanced Security, Monitoring and Users Logs We’re excited to announce a series of significant updates for our Video REC platform this quarter. These enhancements are designed to improve user experience, strengthen security, and expand system monitoring capabilities. The result is a more robust and user-friendly environment for all our valued users. Users Logs Generation and Exportation First and foremost, Video REC now boasts an advanced and comprehensive user log system.

item.title: Transactional Video Calls: Revolutionizing Virtual Interactions
item.description: Photo source: Interactive Powers, Desktop Transactional Video Call Embracing Enhanced Video Capabilities in the Shift Towards Modern Business Communications In today’s digital age, remote communication has become ubiquitous, underscoring the importance of robust and feature-rich video calling platforms. Amidst the myriad options available, Transactional Video Calls shine as a transformative solution, seamlessly integrating with ACD (Automatic Call Distributor) platforms in any IP Contact Center. This integration marks a significant advancement, offering a comprehensive suite of features specifically crafted to address the evolving needs of modern communication.
